keys.name: age
keys.description: The note's age, as free text, because a campaign may count in years, seasons or reigns.

keys.name: aliases
keys.description: Other names the same thing is known by. They are matched when resolving mentions and when completing wikilinks.

keys.name: appearance
keys.description: A physical description used when generating art or describing the note.

keys.name: faction
keys.description: The group the note belongs to. May contain a [[wikilink]] to a faction note.

keys.name: gender
keys.description: The note's gender, as free text.

keys.name: history
keys.description: The turn numbers this note took part in. Written by the engine, not by hand.

keys.name: id
keys.description: The note's stable identity. It is unique per collection and does not change when the note moves between folders.

keys.name: location
keys.description: Where the note is. May contain a [[wikilink]] to a location note.

keys.name: name
keys.description: The display name shown in the codex and used when the engine matches a mention.

keys.name: portrait
keys.description: The path of the note's portrait image, when it has one.

keys.name: portrait_history
keys.description: Previous portrait paths, kept so an earlier portrait can be restored.

keys.name: portrait_version
keys.description: A counter bumped each time the portrait is regenerated, so the client can bust its image cache.

keys.name: state
keys.description: Arbitrary per-note state the mechanics hooks read and write. The engine does not interpret the keys.

keys.name: tags
keys.description: Free-form labels for grouping and search.

keys.name: type
keys.description: What kind of thing the note is. Types that read as a being (character, npc, person, creature) are the only ones the engine treats specially.

keys.name: voice
keys.description: The text-to-speech voice this note speaks with, including pitch and speech rate.
